summary: AXIA Energia S.A. files a 6-K as a foreign private issuer to announce the commencement of a public offering of simple, non-convertible, unsecured debentures in two series under Brazil's automatic registration procedure (CVM Resolution 160). The 10th issuance totals R$2 billion (2 million debentures at R$1,000 par), rated brAAA by S&P. Lead coordinator is Itaú BBA, with Santander, Bradesco BBI, and UBS BB as coordinators. This is a debt capital markets transaction with no equity component, board recommendation, or change of control. Filing is equivalent to a US prospectus filing for a non-convertible bond offer. No special situation event; routine financing.
